title: Brik Project Configuration
description: Declarative project configuration for the Brik portable CI/CD pipeline system. Defines what happens at each stage (stack, tools, thresholds) without describing the pipeline structure itself. The fixed flow Init -> Release -> Build -> Quality/Security -> Test -> Package -> Deploy -> Notify is implemented by platform-specific shared libraries.

version.description: Schema version for brik.yml. Must be 1.

project.description: Project identity and metadata. Required. Provides the name, optional stack hint, and optional monorepo root.

name.description: Project name. Used in logs, notifications, and artefact labels.

stack.description: Technology stack. Optional - Brik performs auto-detection from project files (package.json -> node, pom.xml -> java, etc.) when omitted.

stack_version.description: Stack version for runner image selection (e.g. '22' for node, '21' for java). When omitted, uses the default version.

root.description: Relative path to the service root directory. Used in monorepos where each service has its own brik.yml.

env.description: Path to the project-level env file (KEY=VALUE format), relative to the project root. Optional. When omitted, Brik auto-detects 'brik.env' at the repo root. Existing environment variables (CI secrets, etc.) take precedence over file entries.

release.description: Release stage configuration. Absent means semver strategy with 'v' prefix.

build.description: Build stage configuration. Absent means use stack defaults (e.g. npm run build for node, mvn package for java).

test.description: Test stage configuration. Absent means use stack defaults.

quality.description: Quality stage configuration covering lint, formatting, and type checking. Enabled by default.

security.description: Security stage configuration covering SAST, dependency scanning, secret scanning, license compliance, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

package.description: Package stage configuration for building and publishing artefacts such as Docker images.

publish.description: Publish stage configuration for publishing artefacts to registries (npm, Docker, Maven, PyPI, Cargo, NuGet).

deploy.description: Deploy stage configuration. Defines one or more named environments with conditions and deployment targets.

notify.description: Notify stage configuration for Slack, email, and webhook notifications.

pipeline.description: Pipeline-level configuration (selection mode, per-stage impact globs). Optional; defaults are mode=safe with no per-stage overrides.

hooks.description: Inline pre and post stage hook commands. Evaluated by the shared library (Layer 2). File-based hooks (.brik/hooks/pre-build.sh) are handled separately by the Bash Runtime (Layer 0).

git.description: Git operations configuration. Currently exposes the user identity used by stages that commit or annotate tags (release, gitops deploy).

pipeline.description: Pipeline-level selection settings consumed by the Brik planner. Aggressive mode is reserved for v0.7+ (see ADR-A.7) and currently errors out with a clear message.

mode.description: safe = context-only filtering (default). balanced = adds per-file impact filtering using spec.impact.changes from stage manifests, with optional per-stage overrides under selection.stages. aggressive = per-subproject impact graph; reserved for v0.7+, planner errors with rc=64 if requested.

stages.description: Per-stage impact overrides. Map keyed by stage id (init, release, build, lint, sast, scan, test, package, container-scan, deploy, notify). Each value supplements or replaces the manifest's spec.impact.changes for THIS project only.

changes.description: Glob patterns to consider when deciding whether this stage is impacted by the changed-files set. Use $project.root as the project root placeholder (currently resolved to the brik.yml directory; see monorepo-plan.md).

trigger.description: When the release stage should run. At least one of the flags must be true for the stage to execute. When the entire block is absent, the legacy always-run behaviour is preserved.

on-tag.description: Run when the current commit carries a git tag.

on-main.description: Run on push to the default branch.

manual.description: Run only when the pipeline was triggered manually (BRIK_TRIGGER_MANUAL=true).

profile.description: Git workflow profile that drives candidate detection. trunk-based: candidate on every push to the default branch; git-flow: candidate on release/* branches; github-flow: candidate on every PR-merged commit on main; none: no candidate detection (status quo, the release stage runs only on a tag push). The profile is informational (the planner stamps it into plan.json so adapters can branch on it); the promote stage consumes it to decide whether to push to the candidate or release registry.

candidate.description: Candidate-zone artifact configuration. The candidate zone receives every successful build; the promote stage moves an audited candidate to the release zone on a tag push.

registry.description: Hostname (and optional port) of the candidate Docker registry, e.g. 'registry.candidate.example.com'.

image.description: Image path within the candidate registry, e.g. 'myteam/api'.

release.description: Release-zone artifact configuration. The release zone holds promoted artifacts; the promote stage tags and pushes there once a candidate is approved.

registry.description: Hostname (and optional port) of the release Docker registry, e.g. 'registry.release.example.com'.

image.description: Image path within the release registry, e.g. 'myteam/api'.

enabled.description: Whether to generate a changelog on release.

command.description: Build command to execute. Overrides both tool selection and stack defaults (Tier 1).

tool.description: Build tool to use (e.g. npm, yarn, pnpm, maven, gradle, poetry, uv, pip, pipenv, cargo, dotnet). Overrides auto-detection from lock/marker files (Tier 2). Ignored when command is set.

command.description: Test command to execute. Overrides framework-derived and stack-default commands (Tier 1).

framework.description: Test framework to use. Overrides the stack default (e.g. jest for node, junit for java, pytest for python).

report.description: Path to the coverage report file (Cobertura XML).

reports.description: Test report generation. When enabled, Brik injects framework-specific flags into the test command to produce coverage and JUnit-compatible XML reports for the CI to consume.

enabled.description: Whether to produce test reports. Default: false (test runner uses its native defaults).

coverage.description: Coverage report configuration. Gated by the parent `reports.enabled` toggle.

format.description: Coverage report format. Stack defaults: lcov for node/rust, cobertura for python/dotnet, jacoco for java. Use 'auto' (default) to let Brik pick.

output_dir.description: Directory where the coverage report is written. Default: coverage.

junit.description: JUnit-compatible XML test report configuration. Gated by the parent `reports.enabled` toggle.

output_path.description: Path where the JUnit XML report is written. Default: reports/junit.xml.

enabled.description: DEPRECATED. The runtime no longer honours this key: lint always runs. Init emits a one-shot deprecation warning when 'false' is detected. The key is kept in the schema so legacy brik.yml files keep validating during the migration window; remove it from your config when convenient.

command.description: Lint command to execute. Overrides tool-based and stack-default lint commands (Tier 1).

tool.description: Lint tool to use (e.g. eslint, biome, oxlint, checkstyle, ruff, flake8, pylint, clippy, dotnet-format). Overrides the stack default (Tier 2).

config.description: Path to the lint configuration file (e.g. .eslintrc.yml).

fix.description: Whether to run the linter in auto-fix mode.

command.description: Format check command to execute. Overrides tool-based and stack-default format commands (Tier 1).

tool.description: Formatter to use (e.g. prettier, biome, ruff format, black, rustfmt, dotnet-format). Overrides the stack default (Tier 2).

check.description: Whether to run the formatter in check mode (fail if files would be reformatted) rather than applying changes.

command.description: Type check command to execute. Overrides tool selection (Tier 1).

tool.description: Type checker to use (e.g. tsc, mypy, pyright). Overrides auto-detection (Tier 2).

findings.description: Findings management policy. Selects the built-in preset that decides which findings fail the build vs. are ignored with reason. Org-wide exception lists are configured separately via BRIK_POLICY_URL (a DSI-owned brik-policy.yml).

policy.description: Built-in policy preset. pragmatic (default): ignores findings without an upstream fix or below the severity floor; fails the rest. strict: fails every finding at or above the severity floor, including no-fix entries. permissive: fails only critical findings that already have a fix.

command.description: SAST command to execute. Overrides tool selection (Tier 1).

tool.description: SAST tool to use (e.g. semgrep, sonarqube, codeql). Overrides auto-detection (Tier 2).

ruleset.description: Ruleset or profile for the SAST tool (e.g. auto, p/security-audit).

output_format.description: Format of the SAST report produced for pipeline-report business aggregation. Currently only sarif is supported.

output_path.description: Path (relative to the workspace) where the SAST tool writes its report. Defaults to target/sast.sarif.

command.description: Dependency scan command. Overrides tool-based scanning (Tier 1).

severity.description: Minimum severity level that causes the dependency scan to fail.

tool.description: Dependency scanning tool to use (e.g. npm-audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner).

output_path.description: Path (relative to the workspace) where the dependency scan SARIF report is written. Defaults to target/scan.sarif.

sbom.description: Software Bill of Materials configuration emitted alongside the dependency scan.

enabled.description: Whether to produce an SBOM during the scan stage.

format.description: SBOM serialization format. Currently only CycloneDX 1.5 JSON is supported.

output_path.description: Path (relative to the workspace) where the SBOM is written. Defaults to target/sbom.cdx.json.

tool.description: Secret scanning tool to use (e.g. gitleaks, trufflehog).

output_path.description: Path (relative to the workspace) where the secret scan SARIF report is written. Defaults to target/secret.sarif.

severity.description: Minimum severity level that causes the container scan to fail.

tool.description: IaC scanning tool to use (e.g. checkov, tfsec).

severity_threshold.description: Global minimum vulnerability severity that causes the security stage to fail. Vulnerabilities below this level are reported but do not block the pipeline.

trigger.description: When the package stage should run. At least one of the flags must be true for the stage to execute. When the entire block is absent, the legacy always-run behaviour is preserved.

on-tag.description: Run when the current commit carries a git tag.

on-main.description: Run on push to the default branch.

on-feature.description: Run on push to a branch other than the default (typical use: dev images per feature branch).

manual.description: Run only when the pipeline was triggered manually (BRIK_TRIGGER_MANUAL=true).

docker.description: Docker image build and push configuration.

image.description: Full image name including registry and repository (e.g. registry.example.com/my-service).

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the build context.

platforms.description: Target platforms for multi-arch builds (e.g. linux/amd64, linux/arm64).

build_args.description: Docker build arguments passed as --build-arg. Keys and values must be strings.

registry.description: Metadata about the registry that hosts the published image. Optional; used to enrich the pipeline report.

ui_url.description: Browseable registry UI URL, distinct from the docker push endpoint (Nexus 3 splits these on ports 8081 vs 8082). Surfaced as business.registry.ui_url so the HTML report links to the image page. The BRIK_PACKAGE_REGISTRY_UI_URL env var set on the runner takes precedence over this value.

tag.description: Distribution tag for the published package.

access.description: Package access level for scoped packages.

token_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the npm auth token. Never put the token value here.

docker.description: Push Docker image to a container registry.

image.description: Full image name including registry and repository (e.g. ghcr.io/org/app).

registry.description: Container registry URL for docker login.

tags.description: List of tags to push. If empty, uses BRIK_APP_VERSION.

username_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the registry username.

password_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the registry password or token.

username_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the repository username.

password_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the repository password.

pypi.description: Publish to PyPI or a compatible registry.

token_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the PyPI API token.

cargo.description: Publish to crates.io or a compatible Cargo registry (e.g. Nexus).

index.description: Sparse index URL for the registry (e.g. sparse+http://nexus:8081/repository/brik-cargo/). Required for private registries.

token_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the registry API token.

nuget.description: Publish to NuGet or a compatible feed.

token_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the NuGet token or API key.

trigger.description: When the deploy stage should run. At least one of the flags must be true for the stage to execute. When the entire block is absent, the legacy always-run behaviour is preserved.

on-tag.description: Run when the current commit carries a git tag.

on-main.description: Run on push to the default branch.

on-feature.description: Run on push to a branch other than the default (typical use: review apps per feature branch).

manual.description: Run only when the pipeline was triggered manually (BRIK_TRIGGER_MANUAL=true).

workflow.description: Git workflow convention for automatic environment mapping. When set, Brik loads a built-in profile that pre-configures environments based on branch/tag patterns. User-defined environments override profile defaults.

environments.description: Named deployment environments. Each key is an environment name (e.g. staging, production). Each value defines the deployment condition and target.

env_file.description: Path to the env file (KEY=VALUE format) sourced when deploying this environment, relative to the project root. Optional. Existing environment variables take precedence over file entries. Brik returns an error if env_file is declared but the file is missing on disk.

when.description: Condition expression evaluated by the shared library to decide whether this environment is deployed. Supports branch equality (branch == 'main'), glob matching (tag =~ 'v*'), the pipeline_source subject (pipeline_source == 'merge_request_event'), and BRIK_* environment variables.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace for k8s and helm targets.

manifest.description: Path to the Kubernetes manifest file or directory for the k8s target.

repo.description: GitOps infrastructure repository as a clonable git URL (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com/org/infra.git or git@github.com:org/infra.git). Use `git_token_var` to authenticate without embedding credentials in the URL.

path.description: Path within the GitOps repository where manifests for this service are located.

controller.description: GitOps controller responsible for reconciliation (e.g. argocd, fluxcd).

app_name.description: Application name as known to the GitOps controller.

git_token_var.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the token used to push to the `repo` GitOps repository (e.g. `GIT_TOKEN`). Brik resolves the value indirectly at deploy time and embeds it into the clone URL. Applies to `target: gitops` only.

auth_token_var.description: Name of the environment variable that contains the auth token used to drive the GitOps `controller` (e.g. `ARGOCD_TOKEN`). Brik resolves the value indirectly at deploy time and passes it to the controller adapter. Falls back to the controller's default env var (`ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN` for argocd) when not set. Applies when `controller: argocd`.

chart.description: Helm chart path or repository reference for the helm target (e.g. ./charts/myapp or oci://registry/chart).

release_name.description: Helm release name for the helm target. Defaults to the environment name if omitted.

values.description: Path to a Helm values file for the helm target (e.g. charts/values-staging.yaml).

host.description: Remote host address for the ssh target (hostname or IP).

compose_file.description: Path to the Docker Compose file for the compose target.

remote_path.description: Absolute path on the remote host where the application is deployed (ssh target).

restart_cmd.description: Command to restart the application on the remote host after deployment (ssh target).

source.description: Local path to the artifact directory uploaded by the `ssh` and `compose` targets, or to the rendered manifest tree pushed to the GitOps repo by the `gitops` target. Relative to the project root.

strategy.description: Deployment strategy for targets that support it.

notifyEventList.description: Pipeline events that trigger a notification.

channel.description: Slack channel name including the # prefix (e.g. #deployments).

on.description: Pipeline events that trigger a Slack notification.

to.description: Recipient email address or comma-separated list of addresses.

on.description: Pipeline events that trigger an email notification.
Pipeline events that trigger a webhook call.

hookCommand.description: Inline shell command to execute at a hook point. Multiple commands can be chained with '&&' or ';'.

pre_init.description: Commands executed before the init stage.

post_init.description: Commands executed after the init stage completes successfully.

pre_release.description: Commands executed before the release stage.

post_release.description: Commands executed after the release stage completes successfully.

pre_build.description: Commands executed before the build stage.

post_build.description: Commands executed after the build stage completes successfully.

pre_lint.description: Commands executed before the lint stage.

post_lint.description: Commands executed after the lint stage completes successfully.

pre_sast.description: Commands executed before the SAST scan.

post_sast.description: Commands executed after the SAST scan completes successfully.

pre_scan.description: Commands executed before the security scan stage.

post_scan.description: Commands executed after the security scan stage completes successfully.

pre_container_scan.description: Commands executed before the container scan.

post_container_scan.description: Commands executed after the container scan completes successfully.

pre_test.description: Commands executed before the test stage.

post_test.description: Commands executed after the test stage completes successfully.

pre_package.description: Commands executed before the package stage.

post_package.description: Commands executed after the package stage completes successfully.

pre_deploy.description: Commands executed before the deploy stage.

post_deploy.description: Commands executed after the deploy stage completes successfully.

pre_notify.description: Commands executed before the notify stage.

post_notify.description: Commands executed after the notify stage completes successfully.

user.description: Git user identity applied via 'git config --global' before stages that commit or annotate tags.

email.description: Git user.email. If absent, falls back to CI-platform vars (GITLAB_USER_EMAIL, CHANGE_AUTHOR_EMAIL) then to brik-ci@brik.local.

name.description: Git user.name. If absent, falls back to CI-platform vars then to 'Brik CI'.
